data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 6.1m (2020: favourable development of GBP 11.6m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 6.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 2.9m in respect of total Reinsurance business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 3.7m in Other direct.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Loss exposure on opioids and other pharma losses cited as a driver of reserve uncertainty and management adjustment.
Potential for second order COVID related losses noted as contributing to reserve uncertainty / management adjustment.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate shows a net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 13.1m on gross claims (a release), derived from the gross claims development table. This release was driven by favourable developments primarily in Third Party Liability and reinsurance-accepted business, partially offset by strengthening in Other direct lines; after reinsurance the report records a net favourable development of GBP 6.1m. Management notes ongoing reserve uncertainty from opioid/pharma exposures and possible secondary COVID-19 effects.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 6.1m (2020: favourable development of GBP 11.6m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 6.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 2.9m in respect of total Reinsurance business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 3.7m in Other direct.

At 31 December 2021, the carrying value of net claims IBNR is GBP 314.4m (2020: GBP 274.2m), and the Management Adjustment in excess of the best estimate of net reserves was GBP 37.1m (2020: GBP 31.4m). This level of Management Adjustment is considered appropriate in light of the current economic environment, loss exposure on opioids and other pharma losses, and the potential for second order COVID related losses.
data.data_quality_notes: The movement note (note 6) reports a NET prior year favourable development of GBP 6.1m; a gross prior-year movement was not given there. A gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative payments + estimated balance to pay) - total gross prior-year release computed as approx GBP 13.095m. Triangle-based calculation used because it provides gross figures; confidence rated 0.8 per guidance. RITC activity (transfer to Lloyd's Brussels) is described in the report but the combined effect was stated as having no economic impact; no distortion from RITC was judged to invalidate the triangle for years <=2019.
